recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban composition featuring a group of three men in streetwear, set against a gritty industrial backdrop of blue-tinted walls and metal grates, framed by a metallic diamond-plate border and bold, textured 3D typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal orientation of the subjects mimics the slant of the industrial grates.
The metallic texture of the border is mirrored in the large graphic letterform on the right.
The primary blue background provides a cool-toned contrast to the yellow and white clothing of the subjects.
The 3D gold-toned Roman numerals overlap both the subjects and the background, creating depth.
coreInvariants: Industrial blue and gray color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a diagonal stack from bottom-left to top-center, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, textured 'D' shape on the right side acts as a heavy visual weight balancing the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bright yellow jacket in the center, down to the seated figure, then up the diagonal line of the standing figure to the metallic text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight and cluttered, with negative space limited to the upper right and lower right corners, filled with industrial textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Steel blue and cool gray (background and industrial elements)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and crisp white (subject clothing)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold and vibrant red (typography and small clothing details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark blue shadows and the bright clothing; medium saturation across the board with a grainy, film-like finish.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Integration of industrial textures (diamond plate) into letter fills
Hand-drawn red 'X' mark overlapping main text
Vertical stacking and curved alignment following the shape of larger graphic elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Roman numerals treated as architectural gold bars
Large background letter acting as a container for diamond-plate texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy 3D gold Roman numerals and a textured, flat graphic letterform.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy, industrial weight needed for the base skeleton.
For the small-cap, sharp-serif feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an urban industrial scene with three men in 90s streetwear (yellow parka, white jacket, blue denim) posed diagonally against a blue-tinted wall with metal grates. Apply a canted angle and a metallic diamond-plate border around the entire frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large 3D gold-textured Roman numerals in the center-right. On the far right, add a large graphic 'D' shape filled with diamond-plate texture, with metallic gold text following its outer curve and a red 'X' mark at the top.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle noticeably tilted (Dutch angle)?
Does the typography have a 3D gold metallic effect?
Is the color palette dominated by industrial blue and safety yellow?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any recognizable brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth in the gold lettering.
Ensure the diamond-plate texture is visible in both the border and the graphic elements.
Verify the subjects are arranged in a diagonal stack.
Confirm the background has a distinct blue/industrial tint.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Industrial Blue Backdrop] + [Diagonal Streetwear Trio] + [Diamond Plate Border] + [3D Gold Beveled Typography] to recreate the 90s urban R&B aesthetic.
